card.name: The word controlled after "un"
card.fires_on: The word "controlled" right after "un" in exclusion or contraindication lists, mostly before "hypertension" or "infection".

modes.label: Uncontrolled condition
modes.description: "controlled" completes "uncontrolled" before a condition such as hypertension in lists of exclusions or contraindications.
